_min_tradable_equity_usd_note: Operator override of the derived floor. The derived value is what every enabled book needs to hold a position AT ONCE; below it the first book to fire consumes the budget and the rest sit margin-blocked, which looks from outside like books that do not fire (W-FUND1). $26.0 also acts as a drawdown brake: the system stops rather than grinding down.
_sizing_note:
TESTING SIZE, 2026-09-06, operator's call: keep margin small while the books prove themselves. $11 notional at 3x = $3.67 margin per position, deliberately just above HL's $10.5 MIN_ORDER_USD rather than anywhere near what the account could carry.
  2 concurrent   = $22 notional, $7.33 margin
  risk per trade  = $1.65 at the 15% stop
  worst case      = $3.30 if both stop together, 63% of the $5.20 kill AT THE FLOOR ($26) — and smaller at any higher balance.
Sized from the FLOOR, not today's balance: the config has to stay coherent all the way down to where trading stops, or gates start refusing exactly as the account shrinks.
The kill is a PERCENT. max_daily_loss_pct wins over max_daily_loss_usd in effective_daily_loss_limit, and the two disagreed in this config — the -$10 was dead text while the real floor was -$5.21.
Ceilings replaced, every one sized for a much larger account and inert or harmful here: max_trade_notional_usd 5000, max_total_notional_pct 10.0, short_notional_usd 100, strategy_book_notional_usd 120, daily_giveback_min_peak_usd 25 (a 72% up day, could never arm), min_short_volume_usd $20M (only 6 of 280 xyz markets clear it).
TO SCALE UP: raise notional_usd on the books; every ceiling here is derived from it and the coherence test will tell you what else must move.
_xyz_concentration_note: 2026-09-06: raised from 2 names / 1.05 to 3 names / 1.30 because the 2-name cap was refusing xyz shorts while slots were free (observed: REFUSED SHORT xyz:SNDK, xyz-short name cap reached 2/2). 3 is a CEILING derived from the kill switch, not a preference: xyz shorts are ~1.28 effective bets at 0.83 mean pairwise correlation (W-MATH2/3, 7 stopped together on 07-21 for -$8.59), so size the book as if all of it stops at once. At $11 notional and a 15% stop that is $1.65 per position against a kill of 0.20 x equity = $5.20 at the $26 floor: 2 names = $3.30 (63%), 3 = $4.95 (95%), 4 = $6.60 (127%, i.e. the account loses MORE than the kill switch exists to prevent, before it can fire). 4 is not a tuning choice, it is broken. notional_pct 1.30 admits 3 x $11 = $33 against 1.30 x $26 = $33.80 at the floor and refuses 4 ($44), so both controls agree at the WORST equity rather than only at today's. Past 3 needs smaller positions and $11 is already at MIN_ORDER_USD ($10.5), so 3 concurrent is this account's hard maximum: more THROUGHPUT must come from shorter holds, not more slots.
